question: The Governor of the Reserve Bank of India as of August 2020 was:
solution: The correct answer is __**Shakti Kanta Das.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Presently (as of May 2022) Shri Shaktikanta Das is the present governor of RBI. • The government of India appointed Shaktikanta Das as the 25th governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on 11 December 2018. • He took over as the 25th Governor of the Reserve Bank of India after the resignation of Urjit Patel. • The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet cleared Shaktikanta Das’s appointment for a period of three years. • Sir Osborne Smith was the first governor of RBI. • Shri CD Deshmukh was the first Indian to become governor of RBI. • He has represented India in international fora like the IMF, G20, BRICS, SAARC, etc. Shaktikanta Das
